name: capacities
title: Capacities
description: Capture thoughts to your Capacities daily note and create tasks, straight from the launcher.
author: ianbetteridge

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Generate one in the Capacities desktop app under Settings → Capacities API. Pick the space you want to capture into and grant the api:write scope.

preferences.name: noTimestamp
preferences.title: Daily note
preferences.label: Omit the timestamp heading when saving to the daily note
preferences.description: By default Capacities adds a timestamp heading above each entry appended to the daily note.

commands.name: quick-thought
commands.title: Quick Thought
commands.subtitle: Capacities
commands.description: Save a one-line thought to today's daily note without opening a form.

commands.name: capture-note
commands.title: Capture Note
commands.subtitle: Capacities
commands.description: Write a longer Markdown note into today's daily note.

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: Capacities
commands.description: Create a task with priority, date, deadline and notes.
